title: Load exact bytes and bind every evidence entry deterministically

context.use: Read the entire linked section; normative details override this task summary.
Read the entire linked section; normative details override this task summary.

outcome: Every source evidence entry is loaded once with an exact digest and deterministic stored destination.

artifacts.purpose: Snapshot reads, SHA-256, source-relative evidence resolution
Snapshot manifest and evidence binding records

interfaces: Input: input-file paths and source definitions; output: exact snapshot bytes and indexed evidence records.
Source IDs sort by UTF-8 bytes, evidence by array index; global ordinal paths evidence/n.bin.
Original source paths are resolved only for new submissions; replay consumes bindings instead.
acceptance_criteria: Same-basename and repeated-path entries are copied separately; parent-relative source paths are allowed at ingestion.
Missing files return E_IO; paths/hashes are supplied to validation without moving filesystem access into validation.
Manifest binds source ID, index, original path, stored path, digest; declared but unused sources/evidence are retained.

verification.expected: Exact expected ordering and distinct copies for repeated/basename-collision paths.
Independent digest of loaded/copied bytes matches manifest.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
